# Omarchy P2P Services

Omarchy P2P Services is an Omarchy plugin for controlling supported peer-to-peer services from the desktop shell. The site covers capabilities, installation, settings, status, and releases.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-p2p-services/
- Changelog: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-p2p-services/changelog/

## Source

- Repository: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-p2p-services
- Issues: https://github.com/bolens/omarchy-p2p-services/issues
